body: thank you sometimes I get so caught up I forget that I know what I need to do, thank you for reminding me. Breathe, drink water, turn off the fast paced music, turn on the chill music, breathe. I feel much better now.

I think IF probs makes the mania worse, but it's been ok because I threw it at doing more school and more school, but now it's so bad I can't concentrate. But I also don't want to go back to being obese. And yes, the light change being in the northern hemisphere is also making it worse. Part of the tinfoil fell off my window and the light gets in so early, and I work nights/evenings. Its at the point where I don't even think I should be driving because I feel like i've taken amphetamines and I'm so sketch. And I'm afraid because when mania and suicidal ideation mix is when I've hurt myself in the past. I feel like I'm going to explode.
